messages:
Iris Bennett: Heads-up 10 quick pre-all-hands tech thread. Can AV confirm fallback plan for stream + recording?
Tom Yao: On-site. We have 3 spare HDMI, 1 DP, 2 lavs. Bringing a secondary encoder laptop.
Mika - AV: Running a loudness sweep now. If video drops, we'll switch to slides-only scene and keep audio live.
Lea (Comms): Please remind speakers to use the shared template (high contrast, >18pt). I'll upload the final deck immediately after the event.
Jonah - Product: Q for leadership: will the rollout for smart batching include console recommendations out-of-the-box?
Iris Bennett: We'll ask during product update; if not answered live we'll post a follow-up in #product.
Asha - Security: Quick security note 10 Private deploy slide must mention KMS rotation and SOC audit status.
Mika - AV: Encoder fallback command if ingest fails:
```
# switch to backup ingest and restart encoder
sed -i 's/rtmp:\/\/ingest-main/rtmp:\/\/ingest-backup/' /etc/stream.conf && systemctl restart stream-encoder
```
Tom Yao: Also bring spare USB-C hub for presenter laptop, we saw hub failures in yesterday's rehearsal.
RecordingBot: :white_check_mark: Recording scheduled to start at 16:00 UTC. Auto-archive to /shared/all-hands/2026-07-21/.
Lea (Comms): If recording fails, we'll publish transcript + slides within 2 hours and mark action items.
Mika - AV: Quick tip for captions lag: avoid scene transitions longer than 250ms. Use continuous OBS scene where possible.
Jonah - Product: Live question queued: "How will Dedicated burst capacity be billed? per-minute or daily bucket?"
Iris Bennett: We'll surface that to Product during the Q&A. If no clear answer, Product will publish billing examples post-meeting.
Tom Yao: Note: Roomb mic battery health at 40% 10 swap before go-live.
Asha - Security: Follow-up question for panel: can HSM key rotation be done without session interruption? Need this for compliance.
Iris Bennett: Tagging Security for a short on-stage answer; will capture in notes too.
Mika - AV: If encoder crashes, fallback to audio+slides capture:
```
ffmpeg -f alsa -i default -i slides.mp4 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -c:v copy fallback_audio_slides_$(date +%s).mp4
```
Lea (Comms): Poll for Q ordering pinned. Vote with :thumbsup:. Priority will be Dedicated SLA, Private compliance, Optimize suggestions.
Jonah - Product: Thanks 10 I'll prep short talking points for each.
RecordingBot: :recording: Recording started at 16:01:05 UTC.
Iris Bennett: Live note: drop any last-minute questions here and we'll surface top-voted ones during the Q&A.
Tom Yao: Doing final audio sweep now. Levels at -6dB peak.
Mika - AV: All green from AV; swapping to "slides-ready" scene for the run.
Lea (Comms): Post-meeting: slides + recording link will be posted in #announcements within 1h.
Iris Bennett: Thanks team 12 see you in the green room in 8. If anything breaks, escalate in #eng-oncall. :clap:
